Results.ReviewText: Came with a broken leg. Contacted Weber and shipped a replacement leg just within a few days. Great consumer service! Grill is freaking amazing!! Holds temperature like a boss and it's very intuitive when controlling heat. Love it.

ClientResponses.Response: We are sincerely sorry to hear of your disappointment with our recent change. As of 9/29/23, Mast-Touch kettles have been packaged with Char Rails instead of Char-Baskets. The Char Rails can be used the same way as baskets to facilitate direct or indirect cooking, based on placement on the cooking grate. Some advantages of the Char Rails are enhanced airflow to the charcoal and increased capacity. The baskets are still available as a separate accessory for purchase. One of our care team members will contact you for more information. Thanks!

Not providing the product as advertised is a lack of business integrity. If nobody fixes this for me I'll never buy another weber product again.

Results.ReviewText: It's mostly a big improvement over my 9-year old standard Weber kettle, but that 2-part grate with the removable center is ridiculous and dangerous. You're supposed to be able to hang the grate on the side of the grill, but the center piece always falls out! I've also had to retrieve the fallen center piece from hot coals a few times, because it fits so precariously on the main grate. I ended up buying a ($40 Weber) replacement grate without the center piece just to save my sanity. The lid holder and the coal dividers for indirect grilling are great, though. The wheels are also a big upgrade. I hope it lasts another 9 years, I expect it will!
Results.Title: Great Grill with Annoying Grilling Surface

Results.ReviewText: Awsome charcoal grill, all videos leading me in the way cook anything with great flavors...
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Le Master touch est mon second BBQ Weber,  je possède un Spirit au gaz. Très satisfait des produits Weber, performant, entretien facile et résistant !
Results.Title: Super produit Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is my 4th Weber Charcoal grill and it is outstanding. All of my Weber grills have been great. They are tough and they really do away with the issue of flair ups. If you have a flair up you can adjust the vents if it is a big flair up or a few drops of water if it is small. I recommend Weber Charcoal grills without hesitation.
Results.Title: Weber Charcoal Grill Dominance

Results.ReviewText: I’m 58 years old and this is my third Weber Kettle.   I’ve owned other smokers and grills over the years but if I had to choose just one it would be the Weber Kettle.     You can smoke, bbq and grill anything you want.    You can really dial in the temp you want using the vents.   These units are very durable and the only reason I had to replace my last one after 15 years of use was because a wind storm that damaged the unit when it blew off my patio.    Great product Weber!
Results.Title: Head and Shoulders Above The Rest

Results.ReviewText: I am so glad I went with the MasterTouch. All the extra bells and whistles are 100000% worth it. I’m not a grilling or smoking pro, but I’ve already made some killer chicken wings on this grill a few times to rave reviews. The lid catcher, the thermometer, the insulated handles, the one-touch cleaning system—all so useful. I feel totally satisfied with my purchase and am excited for many more years of smoking and grilling!
Results.Title: MasterTouch absolutely worth the price!

Results.ReviewText:
This was my first kettle, i used to user propane BBQ and normal non covered cheap charcoal. I was advised about this years ago but I went with the cheap open non covered charcoal and the High expensive propane (I was totally wrong, lesson learnt late). After trying the Weber kettle, it's a game changer for BBQ for me. I didn't use the propane since I got it (I didn't know that the cover will control the heat inside the dome as the propane one, but there's a learning curve for this), but once you know how to control the temperature inside and get what you want, I didn't use any of my old BBQ (I dontaned the normal charcoal).
I had added some valuable accessories to it as I noticed this type is super versatile and can be used as Smoker (no need to purchase smoker), rotisserie, Pizza oven and more. I also sealed with $15 gasket (like high end smokers), and it control the temperature way better and save charcoal for more BBQing (they must add this to it)
My family don't like to eat outside anymore, and the food IBBQing is super chef especially after getting help with smart thermometer (I have no idea about BBQing or how to get food with even any Street BBQ quality), now I'm BBQing better than Fancy restaurants and saving ALOT of hundreds and future thousands of dollars.
I love it but learnt the lesson late (but better than nothing)
I started to follow many YouTubers and this specific model is a MASTER of ALL charcoal in the market for years
Thank you Weber
Results.Title: A must have for anyone who wants BBQing

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this charcoal grill and never looked back!
Results.Title: It’s a Weber!

Results.ReviewText:
I love the grill and the way it cooks.  The quality was disappointing, however.  Two problems:
1.  The sockets on the grill bottom were too small to fit the legs.  It was if there was too much 
powder coat or weld slag or something,  I called customer service, and after a rather laborious discussion (the service rep seemed new, and was reading off of one of those hokey scripts like out of country customer service reps from the phone company.  Get rid of the script, train the people, and let them talk normally.  Finally it was decide that Weber would send me a new kettle bottom and legs.  Problem resolved after a week.
2.  The lid thermometer was over 50 degrees off.  (Tested with boiling water).  Called, got a new one sent that is much closer to accurate.   Problem solved, but charge me an extra 10 bucks for the gill and supply a reasonable thermometer.  Otherwise, this is my 7th or 8th Weber, and I remain a loyal customer.
Results.Title: Great Grill, quality issues.

The size is perfect and allows the use of several cooking methods (direct and indirect heat). The companion Weber app has many tutorials, recipes and makes the learning curve much easier to navigate.

Results.ReviewText: I have been cooking with Weber for about  30 plus years and I really enjoy Weber master touch model. I currently own about 4 different models but I always end up using master touch. It’s the correct high and I have all the bells and whistles needed for the cook right on the equipment so it’s very convenient. Weber customer support is also excellent and when I had issues with my kettle they took care of it right away.
Results.Title: Master touch

We did change over to the charcoal rail because of the flexibility to be able to use a larger or smaller area to fill with charcoal vs the baskets can only be used with a set amount. Results.ReviewText:
It looks like they sneakly removed the baskets that used to come with this and replaced it with the harder to use rails...

I did so much research before buying this looking a tonnes of YouTube videos and many videos mentioned upgrading to the master touch over the premium version because you got the baskets and a couple of other things that probably cost the difference in price between them.

So I went for the Master Touch and discover there are no baskets included! I had actually ordered via Home Depot who have the baskets clearly listed as an included item and only cancelled the order and directly purchased from Weber because of the colour choices.

Like with everything these days...higher price, less value.

ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback means a lot to us. We are sorry to hear you are not completely satisfied with your Master Touch Charcoal grill. We will be sure to share this with our management team for consideration. 

The flaps on the grate should be folded over the removeable center to hold it in place when removing it from the grill to load the charcoal. If you need further assistance please reach out direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
Not convinced the upgraded features are worth the money.
I particularly don't appreciate the removable center section of the grill without any self locking feature. I wired mine in place with stainless wire. The fact that it falls out or must be handled separately when lighting and setting the grill in place after dumping the coals from a chimney starter is a hand burner. Bad design.
The tilt up cover is OK but makes working the grill with standard restaurant tongs and the lid hinged up is another hand burner. The lid up reflects heat back to the cooking surface. 
The heavier grate material is a plus but I'm not sure it's different enough from the Original Premium kettle at $220. Same goes for the larger wheels. 
The ash catcher is a nice design improvement but it's also on the Original Premium kettle.

My Bottom Line.. Save $55 and buy the Original Premium 22" Grill.
Results.Title: Weber master Touch Kettle.. Worth the extra $$ ??

Results.ReviewText: I have a Weber genesis and decided to purchase a charcoal grill mostly for nostalgias sake.  I’ve used it handful of times already and the grill itself is wonderful, however, Customer Service has fallen off dramatically since I bought my genesis about seven Years ago.  When I bought my genesis and unboxed it, there was a chip in the porcelain by the thermometer, and I called and spoke to someone who was extremely knowledgeable and immediately sent a replacement and he even sent me a grill cover for the inconvenience free of charge.  With my master, for whatever reason, it did not come with the charcoal baskets that I had seen in every review and every Master touch assemble YouTube videos I’ve seen. I called and spoke to two separate people who didn’t even know what a charcoal basket was and were zero help, and I finally spoke to a third person who finally had a clue and he said that yes they were in fact supposed to come with charcoal baskets, and he would send them out right away. A week later I got a single charcoal basket….  It has been very frustrating.  Weber has outsourced their customer service, Which was not the case years ago.
Results.Title: Customer Service has fallen off dramatically.

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate you providing your feedback on the 22" Master Touch. That is not the experience we strive to provide for our fans. Please let us know if we can do anything to turn your experience around.

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Master Touch Kettle Grill has exceeded my expectations so far with it's versatile design and Exceptional performance. from a wonderfully seared steak to slow cooked stuffed chicken. this has been a very enjoyable grill so far. I had an issue with the top handle when I bought it the warranty department handled wonderfully with out question and sent me a brand new handle. the durable construction and ease of use will give me many more years or grilling pleasure before I have to replace this unit.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
